notes.title: Winning BitSummit Drift PlayStation® Prize
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43973077/4a839b21b547741757ed8c06fd8241da287457bd.jpg[/img]
We are thrilled to announce that we won the PlayStation® Award at the BiSummit Drift, held in Kyoto from July 19-21!

Thank you to everyone who played our demo at the venue!

Additionally, we were also nominated for the  INNOVATIVE OUTLAW AWARD.

Please check out the detailed review on Famitsu.com (Japanese only)
[url=https://www.famitsu.com/article/202407/12320]https://www.famitsu.com/article/202407/12320[/url]

Thank you so much!

notes.title: Exhibit at BitSummit Drift !!
notes.content:
MR. ELEVATOR will be exhibited at BitSummit Drift, an indie game festival to be held July 19-21 in Kyoto!

You can play the first stage in a special demo version available only at the event!
You will be able to enjoy a world view that has progressed even further from the demo version that was recently released during the Steam Next Fest.
We are looking forward to seeing you at the "F-07" booth!

Official website:
[url=https://bitsummit.org/12th/]https://bitsummit.org/12th/[/url]

notes.title: Live Streaming with the director
notes.content:
The director of the in-development game "Mr. Elevator," Takashi Hamada, will be playing the demo version! He will also share behind-the-scenes stories about the game's development while playing, so please tune in!

notes.content:

notes.title: You can now play the Demo in English!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43973077/95c4c6d7ed75cf93498993396954d17bdc901d4e.png[/img]

Dear all! We are very sorry...
There was a mistake in the language switching part of the Demo , and it was not possible to switch from Japanese to English.

The bug has now been fixed. You can now play the Demo with English dialogue and English text, so please give it a try!

notes.title: Announcement of MR.ELEVATOR Demo Release
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience! 
We are excited to announce that the demo version of "MR.ELEVATOR" will be available starting June 10th during Steam Next Fest. 
In this version, you will be able to enjoy one specially prepared stage.

This game allows you to freely walk around and explore the world of this nostalgic Flash game-like game in a 3D space. Although the content is minimal, we hope you will fully enjoy the atmosphere of the game.

Request for Feedback
After playing the demo, please share your feedback with us. We will reflect your feedback in future.

Development is still ongoing, but we are working hard towards the official release. Please look forward to further updates!

We look forward to your play!

notes.title: Tokyo Game Show 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43973077/ab1bc5a5b03470f0b2a08873736a6e7f73e4002e.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=AxtpKODnisw;full][/previewyoutube]

We are thrilled to announce that our game in development, "MR. ELEVATOR", was showcased at Tokyo Game Show 2023 under the "Selected Indie 80" category.

Being on-site, we had the chance to observe various people and their authentic gaming experiences firsthand. Seeing the players right before our eyes naturally evoked feelings of wanting to enhance the game further and the drive to perfect it to the end! We are more motivated than ever and will continue to give our best.

We're honored that IGN has written an in-depth review article about our game. Thank you so much!
Please check out the article through the link below:
https://jp.ign.com/tgs-2023/70851/preview/mr-elevatoradvtgs2023

notes.title: A Fresh Take on Game Development: Unveiling Our Exciting New Approach!
notes.content:
[b]How do you usually make a game?[/b]

In the past, we've used things like white cubes to establish game mechanics and then considered the game world afterward.

However, for this project, we're working closely with visual artists and technical artists to develop the game world alongside the game design. We've just finished the promotional video, and we're excited to share it with you! We're super pumped because this is a pretty different approach from what we've done before.

Our whole team has come together to contribute ideas, and we've packed various elements into this video. It's easy to lose that initial excitement during game development, but we believe this video will serve as a guide for our future development. So, enjoy and stay tuned for more updates!
